Conversation with Gemini

You said

Is there a Stremio and Premiumize.me setup which does the following:


* Resolves the title via IMDB/TMDB/TVDB/TVMaze

* Once the title is resolved, it searches your configured Usenet Newznab indexers for media content

* Presents the NZBs to the user in Stremio

* When a selection for a NZB is made, the .nzb file is pushed to Premiumize.me to download the file into the Premiumize.me Cloud

* Monitor and WAIT for the .nzb file to be downloaded and become available in the Premiumize.me Cloud, and THEN stream the file from the Premiumize.me Cloud in Stremio

Gemini said

Yes, a setup like this exists, but it requires specific "aggregator" addons or a bridge service rather than a single plug-and-play addon like Torrentio.

The closest matches to your workflow are AIOStreams and Comet (self-hosted), often combined with a bridge called StremThru.

The Setup: AIOStreams + StremThru

This is currently the most robust way to achieve the "Search -> Push to Debrid -> Wait -> Stream" workflow for Usenet on Stremio.

  1. Title Resolution: AIOStreams handles title resolution via IMDb/TMDb and can be configured to search your Newznab indexers (via Prowlarr or direct API keys).

  2. The NZB Push: When you select an NZB result, AIOStreams sends it to your configured "Service." While many users use TorBox (which is optimized for this), it also supports StremThru.

  3. The Waiting Logic: StremThru acts as a bridge for Premiumize. It can take the NZB, push it to your Premiumize Cloud, and most importantly, it supports polling.

  4. Streaming: Once Premiumize finishes the download/extraction, the stream is handed back to Stremio.

Alternative: The "TorBox Pro" Shortcut

While you specifically mentioned Premiumize, it is worth noting that the community has largely shifted to TorBox Pro for this exact use case because it is "native."

  • Comet (a high-performance addon) has built-in support for Prowlarr + TorBox.

  • It performs the search, pushes the NZB to TorBox, and has a setting called USENET_REFRESH_ATTEMPTS.

  • This setting automatically checks the cloud status every few seconds. In Stremio, you just see a slightly longer "Loading" screen while the NZB is cached, and then it starts playing automatically without you having to go into a "Downloads" or "Cloud" folder.

How to Build Your Premiumize Setup

If you want to stick with Premiumize, here is the blueprint:

ComponentTool RecommendationPurpose
Search/IndexersProwlarr or NZBHydra2Aggregates your Newznab indexers (Geek, Planet, etc.).
The AddonAIOStreamsResolves metadata and presents the NZB results in Stremio.
The BridgeStremThru (Self-hosted or ElfHosted)Bridges AIOStreams to Premiumize. It handles the "Push NZB" and "Wait for Download" logic.
The ProviderPremiumize.meThe cloud storage where the NZB is actually downloaded and extracted.

Why this isn't "One-Click" (The Technical Gap)

Unlike torrents, Usenet files are often split into many small .rar parts. Premiumize must download all parts and extract them before they are streamable.

  • AIOStreams has a setting: BUILTIN_DOWNLOAD_POLL_INTERVAL. You can set this to check your debrid service every 5–10 seconds.

  • In the Stremio UI, you will click the link, and the addon will display a "Downloading..." status video or a loading screen until the file is ready in your PM Cloud.

Comparison of Usenet Addons

If you are still deciding on the best route, here is how the top Usenet-capable addons compare:

AddonBest For...Supports Premiumize NZBs?
AIOStreamsHighly customized filters & "Waiting" logic.Yes (via StremThru/WebDAV).
CometSpeed and "Cached-like" experience.Primarily via TorBox for Usenet.
